resolution_alignment.current_rules_summary: Up if the Chainlink-generated BTC TWAP over the stated market range is greater than or equal to the price at the beginning of that range; otherwise Down.
resolution_alignment.note: Preserve exact resolutionSource/rules text and rules hash per market; re-verify before live trading.

research_goal.acceptable_interpretation: May be achievable only on a high-confidence subset; profitability and calibration matter.

infrastructure_policy.preferred_compute_candidate: Oracle Cloud Always Free A1 if available

known_damaged_raw_interval.training_policy: Exclude from raw-dependent training unless independently recovered from a trustworthy source.

rollout_coverage_limitation.interpretation: Surviving VM artifacts do not prove whether the earlier local raw absence was pruning history or capture downtime. Treat this rollout-era interval as unavailable for raw-dependent research unless independently reacquired; compact-state absence before rollout is not evidence by itself of recorder downtime.
